notes: Chroma Audio Suite 2026.11.19: Shared Direct2D GPU renderer across ChromaVerb v3.1.0 (175.5 FPS + host keystroke stack-overflow fix) and ChromaMaster v1.3.0 (limiter IM overhaul, ADSR envelope, 5-band moveable parametric EQ, cached GPU spectrum & 3D waterfall); ChromaCore v2.9.6 (88 presets with 15 new dry/calm organic pads, plucks & hybrid keys, top FX tab LEDs/bypass, and up to -35% audio-thread CPU); ChromaPulse v3.3.0 (streaming 16-pad WAV auto-slice); and ChromaVoice v3.3.0 (vocal sensor + Circle-of-5ths harmonic layering).

ChromaCore.notes: ChromaCoreVST v2.9.6 (2026.11.18): Expanded factory roster to 88 presets with 10 purpose-built calm organic pads, woody/acoustic plucks, electric keys, and dual-envelope pluck-into-pad hybrids plus 5 clean dry essentials; added top FX tab active LED indicators and 1-click bypass; optimized audio-thread DSP (16-sample VCO drift, gated Mod Osc, muted-oscillator skipping) plus LTCG for up to 35% lower CPU.

ChromaCorePro.notes: Unified into ChromaCoreVST v2.9.6: Updating automatically merges legacy ChromaCorePro into ChromaCoreVST.dll with 88 factory presets, top FX tab LEDs and 1-click bypass, audio-thread CPU optimizations (up to -35%), Osc 4 Resampler, and 14-source Mod Matrix.

ChromaPulse.notes: ChromaPulse v3.3.0 (2026.11.18): Added streaming WAV auto-slicer into all 16 drum pads with 2 ms anti-click fades, automatic Choke Group 1 assignment, automatic loudest 16-second window detection for long audio files, and a [NEXT SEC >] section cycle control.

ChromaDeep.notes: ChromaDeep v2.9.0 (Phase 2 update 2026.11.15): Cached AdditiveEngine partial amplitude table & trig rotation recurrence (bit-exact max_sample_diff=0), 32-bit DIB deck/wave caches, ChromaFastText, GetUpdateRgn culling (0.86ms live paint, 0.0/s idle), tail-aware idle bypass (0.02% idle CPU), ZDF 4-Pole Tube Ladder, and analog per-voice stereo spread.

ChromaX.notes: ChromaX v2.9.0 (Phase 2 update 2026.11.15): Added 32-bit DIB backbuffer, ChromaFastText, clip culling, eased meters, and tail-aware idle bypass (0.13% idle CPU, 3.05ms live paint, 0.0/s idle repaints), plus analog polyphonic stereo voice panning, VCO thermal drift, inter-stage tube ladder filters, and Class-A AnalogConsoleStage output.

ChromaComp.notes: ChromaComp v2.9.2 (2026.11.17): Upgraded PrecisionBiquad coefficients, filter state, design math, and magnitude display to double precision with 1e-8 unit-circle sanitization (63,504/63,504 designs Ok, 0 nudged across 44.1–192 kHz); very low boosted shelves and low cuts now land exactly where set at 88.2–192 kHz.

ChromaVerb.notes: ChromaVerb v3.1.0 (2026.11.18): Full Direct2D + DirectWrite hardware-accelerated UI (175.5 FPS / 5.7 ms frame time, 256-bin spectral persistence cloud, interactive Decay + Post EQ); eliminated host keystroke stack-overflow crash via direct effEditKeyDown/KeyUp dispatch and _resetstkoflw recovery in ChromaHostShield.

ChromaDelay.notes: ChromaDelay v2.9.0 (Phase 2 update 2026.11.15): Added 32-bit DIB cache, ChromaFastText, dirty-rect clipping, and idle audio bypass (0.13% idle CPU, 1.87ms live paint, 0.0/s idle repaints), plus NaN/Inf self-healing and Jury pole stability across BBD, Tape, Oil-Can, Digital, and Shimmer engines.

ChromaFhaser.notes: ChromaFhaser v2.9.2 (2026.11.17): Upgraded 24-band EQ Biquad coefficients, state, design math, and magnitude readout to double precision (54,432/54,432 designs Ok, 0 nudged across 44.1–192 kHz); very low boosted shelves and low cuts now land accurately at 88.2–192 kHz.

ChromaSlice.notes: ChromaSlice v2.9.0 (Phase 2 update 2026.11.15): Added 32-bit DIB cache, ChromaFastText, dirty-rect clipping, and idle audio bypass (0.03% idle CPU, 3.52ms live paint, 0.0/s idle repaints), plus 2x ADAA analog warmth and Clipboard [FEEDBACK] diagnostics.

ChromaTransientShaper.notes: ChromaTransientShaper v2.9.0 (Phase 2 update 2026.11.15): Added 32-bit DIB cache, ChromaFastText, dirty-rect clipping, and idle audio bypass (0.03% idle CPU, 0.17% active DSP, 4.21ms live paint, 0.0/s idle repaints), plus 2x ADAA clipper stage and Clipboard [FEEDBACK] diagnostics.

ChromaVoice.notes: ChromaVoice v3.3.0 (2026.11.18): Added intelligent vocal presence sensor, Circle-of-5ths harmonic doubler and tripler voicing modes, low-latency non-ASIO buffer crackle hardening, and preserved WARP Granular OLA transient accuracy.

ChromaWidener.notes: ChromaWidener v2.9.1 (2026.11.17): Eliminated all 30 static GDI+ objects to prevent DLL_PROCESS_DETACH loader-lock teardown crashes on device_remove; added 250ms time-bounded effSetSampleRate guard with deferred resume; and updated LifeGuard/module-pinned shields.

ChromaDesigner.notes: ChromaDesigner v2.9.0 (Phase 2 update 2026.11.15): Added 32-bit DIB cache, ChromaFastText, dirty-rect clipping, and idle audio bypass (0.03% idle CPU, 0.35% active DSP, 0.29ms live paint, 0.0/s idle repaints), plus Dual 500-Series D.E.T. rack UI and 2x ADAA console bus stage.

ChromaScramble.notes: ChromaScramble v2.9.0 (Phase 2 update 2026.11.15): Added 32-bit DIB curve cache, ChromaFastText, GetUpdateRgn culling, and tail-aware idle bypass (0.02% idle CPU, 2.8ms full repaint, 0.0/s idle repaints), plus Low-Color Hardware Theme, 3D protruding titanium knobs, 10-module MSEG engine, and 2x ADAA warmth.

ChromaMaster.notes: ChromaMaster v1.3.0 (2026.11.18): Overhauled maximizer limiter (-24.9 dB intermodulation reduction on heavy bass, -20% CPU); added maximizer ADSR envelope, 5-band moveable parametric EQ with docked EQ/SPACE panel and mono-safe stereo space delay; upgraded to cached Direct2D GPU spectrum & batched 3D waterfall renderer plus LTCG build optimization.
